players.bio: Aaron John Drinan (born 6 May 1998) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. He played youth football for Irish sides Carrigaline United, Cobh Ramblers and Cork City, before joining League of Ireland side Waterford in 2017, making his senior debut in August 2017.
Anthony Munda (born 8 September 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swindon Town on loan from Newcastle United.
Antwoine Hackford is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Swindon Town.
Ben Middlemas (born 13 December 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swindon Town.
Billy Naylor Kirkman (born 26 February 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays for Swindon Town, as a left back.

Connor James Ripley (born 13 February 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. Ripley turned professional at his local team Middlesbrough – where his father, Stuart, had played – in January 2011, though he would play only three first-team games in eight years at the club.

Dan Butler is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Swindon Town in EFL League Two, where he is currently on a season-long loan from EFL League One club Stevenage. Career Portsmouth Early career Butler joined Portsmouth's youth categories in 2004, aged 10, and signed a two-year scholarship with Pompey on 15 July 2010.
Daniel James Butterworth (born 14 September 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.

Filozofe Mabete is a professional footballer who currently plays as a center-back for National League club Forest Green Rovers, on loan from Swindon Town. Mabete, born in London, progressed through the Wolves academy, making significant strides in the club's youth ranks.
Fletcher William Holman (born 12 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.
Gavin Kilkenny (born 1 February 2000) is an Irish footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.

Harry Roy Smith (born 18 May 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. Smith played youth football for Brentford, Chelsea and Gillingham, before playing non-league football for Sevenoaks Town, Sittingbourne and Folkestone Invicta.
Ian Scott Holloway (born 12 March 1963) is an English professional football manager, former player, media personality and television pundit who is the manager of EFL League Two club Swindon Town.
Jack Thomson (born 20 January 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two side Swindon Town.
James Ball (born 1 December 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swindon Town.

James Boluwatife Debayo is an English professional footballer who plays as a center-back for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. He is currently on a season-long loan from Premier League side Hull City.

Jaylan Bradley Pearman is a 20-year-old Australian professional football player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for EFL League Two club Swindon Town, on loan from EFL Championship team Queens Park Rangers (QPR).
Joseph Leonard Snowdon (born 14 February 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swindon Town.
Joel McGregor is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Swindon Town F.C. in EFL League Two.
Joseph Oluwagbemiga Mayowa Hungbo (born 15 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Swindon Town .

Kaelan Andrew Moore Majekodunmi born 21 February 2004) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. Born in England, he represents Australia at youth level.
Lewis Moore Ward (born 5 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swindon Town.
Louis Millard is an English-born Kenyan professional footballer who plays as a attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.
Matthew Joseph Virtue-Thick (born 2 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays for Swindon Town, as a midfielder. He has previously played for Blackpool, Liverpool and Notts County.

Mitchell Reece Clark is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. He has represented Wales at youth level. A graduate of the Academy at Aston Villa, he spent the 2018–19 season on loan at Port Vale. He joined Leicester City in July 2019 following his release from Aston Villa.

Oliver Anthony Clarke (born 29 June 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. After progressing through the Bristol Rovers youth system, Clarke joined the professional ranks at The Pirates in 2009.
Oliver James Palmer is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.

Paul Milton Glatzel (born 20 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. Born in England, he has represented both England and Germany at youth level.
Ryan Sirous Tafazolli is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Swindon Town.

Samuel Lawrence Inwood (born 17 September 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two side Swindon Town on loan from EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Born in England, he plays for the Northern Ireland U21 team.

Tom Andrew Nichols (born 28 August 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or striker for EFL League Two club Swindon Town. Having come through Exeter City's academy, Nichols made his first-team debut for the club in May 2011.
